notes.title: 20250718 V1.3.3.0 update
notes.content:
1: Bookshelf functionality has been updated. Now, disciples of a sect can learn sect martial arts and internal cultivation by reading books on the bookshelf. Sect martial arts are divided into three levels: beginner (outer sect disciples), intermediate (inner sect disciples), and advanced (elders and sect leaders). Books of different levels require corresponding status to read. You can switch the current book level in the bookshelf categories. Repeatedly reading martial arts and internal cultivation you have already learned will increase experience points. Reading books on the bookshelf consumes mental energy and martial arts insights. During gameplay, if players feel that the consumption of martial arts insights required for reading the bookshelf is excessive, we will adjust the consumption based on feedback.



2: A new ‘stealth reading’ feature has been added, allowing players to learn martial arts even if they are not disciples of a sect or do not meet the required status. The effects of stealth reading are equivalent to regular reading. However, please note that sects strictly protect the books on the bookshelf, and stealth reading is highly likely to be detected and punished. We will adjust the probability of detection or add new event branches based on feedback in the future.



3: The sect's style system will now be determined by the books on the bookshelf. When players create their own sect, they can place the internal martial arts they want disciples to practise on the bookshelf in the training room, and disciples will automatically begin practising. Note that when there are multiple training rooms, players must manually select which training room's style to activate. The new style system can be accessed via the Social - Sect Management - Style Management button.



4: We have updated the rumours in the Jianghu. Now, different rumours will be displayed in the Dahuang Realm and the Small World. We will continue to update more exploration rumours in the future.



5: Added some new plot events.



6: Fixed an issue where some sect buildings were unclaimed due to ID conflicts.

notes.title: Version 1.3 (Great Wilderness World) Update
notes.content:
How to switch to the large map branch


Due to the fact that the Great Wasteland has been transformed into a complete map in this update, we have split the content of version 1.3 into different branches to avoid some players being unable to adapt to the significant changes. Players can choose the branch they wish to play from.



Right-click on the game in your Steam library, select ‘Properties,’ and choose the “Beta” branch ‘oudertest1.3-Large Map Version Branch.’



This will allow you to play in large map mode. To play the older version of the game, switch the branch to ‘None’ to revert to the default version.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/8e7e15e53ebf0d645fecc5f3a09fbd4b044a2b40.png"]


Update Content Overview1. Great Wilderness World map overhaul
The first world upon launching the game is now a seamless Great Wilderness map. Players will be born and explore within this world.

The main storyline before the Kungfu Contest mission has been completely remade. We welcome everyone to experience it and share your feedback with us.

The previous map gameplay will be retained in the Small World

Note for migrated saves: to explore new content in the Great Wilderness world, you must reset/recreate the Great Wilderness region in your save file.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/fba91aa08addacc9b52fb357379ac6d2e1a60061.png"]
2. New Challenge‑duel system
When issuing a Sect Challenge, the game enters a special duel interface.

Players can freely choose characters for combat.

During fights, you may use support actions like Inspire, Sneak attack, and Taunt.

NPCs will use these support actions too, based on their personality—counter-effects are possible.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/1b0fd9d9aab67a7e0e7759eaf746dfb794e3e869.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/d979c3011f22eacb2f0eac0abba6241becd44fd4.png"]
3. New Sect interface
We’ve overhauled the Sect menu and sect tax logic.

Now sect taxes yield only virtual resources, usable directly for constructing buildings.

Current functions include expanding sect territory and upgrading—more sect features will be added in version 1.3.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/d2b7e5fa1cda758235b75015b8db2ba465bbb0b4.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/d2b7e5fa1cda758235b75015b8db2ba465bbb0b4.png"]
4. Map exploration
The new open world is still sparsely populated—please forgive the early-stage emptiness.

Feel free to freely explore the Great Wilderness.

If you encounter interesting locations, please take screenshots and post them in the group. Any rare event ideas or exploration spots are welcome and may be used for future content.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/4d1981baa877c20ae26596a51f6788f7b059eabd.png"]

Note: In this version, some areas may have pathfinding errors causing players to fall through the map into water. If that happens:

use the Teleport button in the cheat menu.

notes.title: Version 1.2 Beast Battle Update Introduction
notes.content:
Greetings, heroes! After a month of testing the 1.2 version, we are finally ready to release it to the public. We would like to express our sincere gratitude to all the heroes who participated in the 1.2 version test branch. Your valuable feedback has helped us optimize and fix numerous issues. We hope that all other heroes will enjoy this update and experience something new.
In the next version, we plan to optimize the AI and further optimize and deepen the content related to the sects. A detailed update preview will be released to everyone in the future. 

Brief introduction to the 1.2 update

Simplified the commission system, which has been integrated with the original quest system.

Added a tomb sweeping system, which allows you to carry teammates in a team to sweep their tombs to comfort their souls, improve their spirits, and remove the effects of the death of a loved one.

Added multiple skills, inner kungfu, and mnemonics. 

Added a new way to equip mnemonics. Some mnemonics can be equipped on the personal page to obtain special effects.

Most importantly, the Beast Battle gameplay has been updated. When your Taming skill reaches level 2, you can train and fuse beasts, fight against other NPCs in battles, and participate in special Beast Battle tournaments to earn rare rewards.

Fixed bugs related to Merit, combat freezes, and game freezes.

You can now exchange your identity with the bartender (once every 3 days), and animals will now be permanently immune to land attribute effects.

Optimized button operations, you can use TAB to close the secondary menu, and a new feature has been added to persuade the Imperial Guards to leave the Imperial Guards.

Heroes, hurry up and train your peerless beasts!

1.2 Version Detailed Update Introduction


1. Commission System

The current version of the commission system has been iterated and upgraded. Commission tasks accepted from NPCs will now be directly displayed in the task interface.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/39c049604e92f137949636f51282152a29c87c64.png

2. Beast Fighting System

I. Beast Fighting

After reaching level 2 in taming, you can summon a tamed animal to make it your current beast. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/126ce2aac5f547bd7cd66f710ac0bc02f3b2af07.png

Select an NPC with the same beast to fight. You need to place a bet before the fight, and you will receive the prize if you win

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/f71026305c2243afdc46d6c4a41eba70ebf77909.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/e41dbf961b774a6711f925e6dfa71f555ea3c08c.png

During battle, after each round, players will need to choose a beast to strengthen their own beasts.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/f614216652db9dba0347a4029db5d594315a08b4.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/8bc6b3eae6abb43d7a9715c2b21136e068d72f92.png

2. Beast Training

Players can train their beasts in the Management section.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/366e86c6a5ca9a04413b2230f26731cfe65b05eb.png

Moves: The moves that beasts use in battle will trigger certain effects.

Bonds: Beast enhancements have different bonds, which will be upgraded when enhanced.

Attributes: The basic attributes of beasts.

Talents: The talents of beasts, which have various effects.

Players can train beasts by feeding them and consuming other animals.

Enhancement: The experience bar below the animal's name. Experience can be gained through beast battles, and after leveling up, you can choose 1 of 3 beast enhancements.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/fc8aa2a18254518b0daaa4b14fbad08a58fe0e63.png

3. Beast Battle Quest

After obtaining a beast, unlock the Ten Thousand Beasts Mountain Villa plot and find an NPC above the inner disciple level to participate in the Beast Battle.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/bd080c28fd61e46d450ea0a7c58946244b174486.png

Players need to pay a registration fee and choose their opponents. The beast battle starts with 16 players, and you need to win 4 consecutive battles to become the champion and receive valuable rewards.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/06786860855546502972ce9b5fa33648bbe6328a.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/6049c4062371ee087c7a710d9cc08ab81af032e6.png

Other Updates and Improvements

1. The blacksmith and bartender NPCs will now sell basic equipment, brewing-related items, and blueprints.

2. Animals are now permanently immune to plot attributes.

3. You can now exchange your identity with the bartender (once every 3 days).

4. Added Korean localization.

5. Optimized button operations; you can use TAB to close the secondary menu.

6. Added a dialogue function to persuade the Imperial Guards to leave the Imperial Guards.

Bug fixes

1. Fixed an issue where burying people did not add Merit and incense burners could not be used for worship.

2. Leaving a sect will now properly clear law enforcement rights.

3. Players now have a minimum number of moves in battle to prevent them from being stuck in combat.

4. Fixed some other bugs that would cause the game to freeze.

Thank you to all the heroes who have continued to support us! We still have many ideas and optimizations in progress, so we hope everyone will be a little more patient. We also hope that everyone will provide more feedback and comments on our updates. Thank you, heroes!

The Matchless Kungfu Development and Distribution Team
April 24, 2025

Issues and bugs found during testing can be reported in discord, but you need to specify that they are bug submissions from the test branch.


Test Content Introduction

We will gradually update the test content during the testing phase.

It is highly recommended that you migrate your official version saves to the test version for testing.

1: The commission system has been redone. Now, NPCs will generate commissions based on various conditions, and you can view the commissions at the envelope icon in the lower-left corner. The original tasks can also be abandoned.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/8f535fd47fe368fdafd61c12603aad3253484c11.png

When both the player and the opponent have pets, you can choose "Beast Battle" during actions to engage in a betting fight. Depending on different conditions, different bet options will be displayed. The bets may also vary somewhat due to NPC personality differences. During battle, once one side finishes their move for a few seconds, the round ends. Then you can choose to enhance abilities. Enhancing abilities will provide a bond effect on the left side. (Since the pet growth system is not yet complete, refresh and pet personality growth are not yet available; you can only experience basic battles.) If a pet’s momentum (HP) drops to zero, it fails. If a pet's anger meter fills up, it will unleash its ultimate move; different pets have different ultimate effects. (Currently not viewable.)

"Stormy Swift Sword" is obtained by completing the Star Web Sword Network related task.  
"Lion's Roar Skill" is obtained by completing the Knife Fanatic Sword Maniac related task.  
"Soul Devouring Great Method" is obtained by sparring with Dark Delivery of Impermanence at a certain chance.  
"Drifting Swordplay" is obtained by sparring with Wandering for Swords at a certain chance.  
(Mnemonics and Inner Kungfu are not yet released.)

Pet Battle Testing Methods

After opening the cheat page, click "Add Pet", choose a pet, and then select an NPC to assign the pet to.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/b9e8da83b510011f6f7e31b89a2e78df481e10a4.png

If an NPC has multiple pets, one pet will be randomly selected to battle.  
If a player has multiple pets, they can use the subordinate management, click "Summon" to call one pet to their side for battle.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/6d733d90635e8c709a00526bceae846bf79f4303.png

Note: In the current version, the subordinate page will only update its display after the pet has arrived; it will not update immediately. This will be optimized in a future update.

notes.title: German & Russian Localization Update! Beast Battle Tournament Update Preview!
notes.content:
German and Russian Localization Update! Beast Battle Tournament Update Preview!

In this update, we've added Russian and German localization. However, due to the lack of team members with relevant cultural backgrounds, we used AI translation followed by manual proofreading. There may be some issues with the translations. If you have any suggestions or corrections during gameplay, feel free to join our Discord channels for German or Russian to discuss with us. We will also continue to update new language localizations in future updates.

Russian language player concordance list:
1. EkemRoht
2. SuperMan4eg
3. Anonymous User

Special thanks to: community administrator yewtm

Upcoming Changes and Adjustments

We have postponed the AI optimization and identity gameplay update to version 1.3 (slight delay). In the next version (1.2), we will introduce the brand-new Beast Battle Tournament system (with a pet training feature, the ability to battle NPCs in Beast Battles, and new events, new storylines, new skills, and new mnemonics).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/5515d84ed135bf54afc27ab4d535fedd711627ec.png

We will also be optimizing and iterating on the commission and event systems. The commission system will become independent of the current task system and will become individual requests from NPCs. Rewards will be adjusted based on the commissioner's strength and task difficulty.

For event-related content, we've optimized the logic to execute multiple events separately without interference (reducing the issue where an event may be interrupted by another, preventing the triggering of the second event).

Public Testing Branch Activation

The Matchless Kungfu will start the Steam public testing branch with version 1.2. Due to differences in player computer configurations and the game's design freedom, we find it difficult to pinpoint some players' bugs. In future updates, we will release some new version content to the testing package before the update, allowing you to experience it and help us with optimization to improve the final version's game quality. After the testing begins, all players who have purchased The Matchless Kungfu or will purchase it in the future can find the The Matchless Kungfu Test Server tool in their library.

Remember to select the tool in your library.

Before the next test, we will release a more complete introduction to the testing content and detailed instructions on how to use the testing package. Once again, we thank all of you for your continued support! We will keep updating and enhancing your gaming experience!

notes.title: December Version Update Announcement
notes.content:
Dear Heroes,

Long time no see! It has been over 40 days since the official release of The Matchless Kungfu. Now, it’s time to bring you the promised updates! The first medium-to-large-scale update since the official release is finally here!

Focus After This Update
Following this update, we will concentrate our efforts on optimizing NPC AI, improving game performance, and further developing identity-based gameplay mechanics.

Next year, we will launch public test builds for game testing. All players who have purchased The Matchless Kungfu will automatically unlock the The Matchless Kungfu Test Server tool in their libraries. Details regarding the test content and the availability of the tool will be shared in future Flying Pigeon Messages (announcements).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/413c82523c141d9fed2aa3488ea79775c9466349.png

We plan to add Russian and German localization (optimized machine translation) in the next major update. If you'd like to help us with translations in other languages, feel free to join our Discord and contact our community managers.

Summary of Update Content

Title System
The Title System has been introduced, allowing players to earn and display unique nicknames that reflect their martial identity.

NPC Personality Traits
NPCs now feature diverse personality tendencies. Unique combinations of traits make NPCs more distinctive and lifelike, enhancing interaction and immersion.


New Skills and Mnemonics
This update introduces new skills and mnemonics. Additionally, new martial arts experts, including those with Transcendence-level mnemonics, are now available for players to encounter and challenge.

Sect Rule Optimization
The rules and mechanics of sects have been refined. Players can now apply for enforcement authority, enabling them to perform law enforcement duties within their sects.

Resource Sharing in Construction
When constructing or producing items, players can now directly utilize resources from all player-owned chests located in the same tile.

Musical Instrument Gameplay
New melodies have been added for playing the qin (zither). Players will now hear beautiful music when performing.

Sleep to Skip Time
A new feature has been added to allow players to skip time by sleeping, making gameplay more flexible and convenient.


Detailed Update Introduction

Title System
Players can now equip their Transcendence-level mnemonics as titles in the left-hand section of the skills interface. The equipped mnemonic’s name will become the player’s title.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/0ea47f7834262bd7109a34f671662adceea30ee7.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/14b10d64d4574666b4368718a564ee5561cbd4b5.png

NPCs with Transcendence-level mnemonics will automatically equip their most recently acquired mnemonic as their title.

Title Inclinations
Titles will have various inclinations, represented by different colors. NPCs with different personalities will react uniquely to these inclinations.

For example:
Upright individuals will gain 20 Disdain upon seeing an Evil-inclined title.
Conversely, they will gain 20 Admiration upon seeing a Heroic-inclined title.

NPC Personality Tags
Newly generated characters will now feature personality tags.


NPC Personality Tags

Newly generated characters will now feature personality tags.

Each NPC will be assigned 3–5 random personality tags, forming a unique combination that defines their overall personality.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/0e66ae73ef908b2865f404eddc27afd76cf4de54.png

Impact on NPC Behavior
Different personalities will influence how NPCs approach situations and interact with others.

Personality determines the NPC’s subjective behavior.
Reputation represents how others objectively evaluate the NPC.
Future Updates for Personality Effects

Future updates will add more gameplay effects based on personalities.
For instance:
Compassionate NPCs who work as doctors will offer 50% discounted treatment prices.
They will proactively assist players in poor health.

Gameplay Optimization Overview

Open World Enhancements
Invite NPCs to Drink or Relax in Hot Springs

NPCs who join a player’s team can now be invited to drink or relax in hot springs. This helps them recover Spirits and alleviate Hidden Ailments.
Each decoration item has a limit on the number of NPCs it can accommodate.
Players need to cover the costs when inviting NPCs. Fees will be deducted immediately upon invitation; insufficient funds will prevent invitations.
Players do not need to pay fees when using their own table decorations, but they must prepare wine and cooked dishes in advance. Each NPC consumes 1 wine and 1 dish during their visit.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/eb0caec32f71dddacd93ea9a856df556460ba3ce.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/d6c3c75084d77a994056eddabacc42a4e319f5b6.png


Feeding Function in Help Menu

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/3c1c3bf38e0dcb0478eeb17e8450b6e3bb898ea7.png

A new “Feed” button has been added to the Help Menu.

Players can feed items to NPCs with a Favorability of 100 or higher.

Sect-Related Enhancements

Post-Elimination Actions

After destroying an opposing faction, players can immediately choose whether to inherit the abilities of that faction.
NPCs from defeated factions will apply to join the victorious faction (randomly assigned).
Sect Rules System Optimization

Adjustments ensure that sect rules are only violated if the player is caught by NPCs.
Players can now apply for the authority to enforce sect rules themselves.

Construction and Crafting Optimization

Resource Sharing Within the Same Location
Players can now select resources from their backpack or the inventory of any chests they own within the same location when producing items or constructing buildings.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/e009387364ad31c1115fa7e0508b34a947dfa5d2.png

New Feature: Sleep to Skip Time

A new feature allows players to skip time by sleeping.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/5811ed5b5e6e1c93d4350149f42f682183c1ad2b.png

Lute Music Enhancement

New lute music has been added! Now, playing the lute will produce music.


That concludes the updates for this version. In the coming year, we plan to engage more with everyone, involving you in the open testing or sharing developer logs to update you on the progress of the game. We deeply appreciate your support, and wish all heroes a prosperous, carefree, and smooth new year. Happy New Year!


The Matchless Kungfu Development and Publishing Team
December 30, 2024

notes.title: The Matchless Kungfu 1.0 Release Announcement
notes.content:
It has been quite some time! 

A year and three months have passed since we launched the game in Early Access. Over this period, we’ve been encouraged and guided by all your support and feedback. In each update, we’ve aimed to preserve the freedom that defines The Matchless Kungfu. However, some versions may have felt restrictive or less considered due to our spur-of-the-moment inspiration. We've balanced and refined these elements now, though inevitably, some issues may still need further polish. We hope you’ll continue to offer your valuable feedback as we keep improving!


The version number for this update is V.1.0.0.0, and we’re not stopping here. As always, the full release is just a new beginning for us. On November 7th (tomorrow!), we’ll share our development roadmap for the period through February 2025.


1.Full Release FAQ (Answers to the Most Commonly Asked Questions)

Q: Can Early Access save files be used in the full release?
A：We understand that Early Access saves represent your hard work and memories in the game. You can load old saves, but please note! As version 1.0 adopts a new save data structure, to ensure the best gameplay experience, we recommend deleting all old save data and starting the game with a new save We’ve rewritten many events, enhancing character and NPC development, and using old saves might lead to data inconsistencies.

Q: The sects feel similar—other than different skills, they don’t seem very unique.
A：Version 1.0 ntroduces three new sects: Skyforge Pavilion, Linglang Swordhouse, and the Esoteric Buddhist Sect. Existing eight sects now also have unique faction gameplay, and the hidden sect Heaven's End Palace features special mechanics. See below for further details. Additionally, we’ve optimized skills and Inner Kungfu acquisition; sect skills now require consulting with the Salute for instruction.


Q: Are NPC AIs still as limited as before, freezing when out of range?
A: In the last update, we added an NPC AI LOD feature, adjustable based on your system configuration (default is set to 1x). However, due to the underlying logic of the game designed by NPC AI, it is not easy to change them, we’ll begin a complete overhaul of the NPC AI system after the 1.0 release.

Q: All skills are too easy to obtain by repeatedly consulting and boosting favorability
A: We’ve reworked the training and consultation systems. Consulting for skills and Inner Kungfu now grants insights rather than immediate mastery. Characters progress based on their comprehension ability, and consulting multiple NPCs on the same skill can speed this up. Also, when instructing NPCs, rapid consecutive instruction now yields only one favorability boost. 
(Sect-exclusive skills are restricted to NPCs within the same sect.)

Q: Combat becomes too easy in the later game; connecting Inner Kungfu techniques allows one-hit victories.
A: We’ve rebalanced combat. Technique power now has a greater impact on skill damage, while Inner Kungfu influence on technique damage is reduced.



Q: The Geomancy skill's theft limit is strange; success should allow taking everything.
A: We’ve overhauled skills like Geomancy and Fly On Snow. Now, there’s no limit to theft amount, and the higher your Geomancy ability, the higher your success rate in stealing and lockpicking. Higher Geomancy levels are also required to access certain special shelves.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/72615ea1833198b02a6d49407dd10d95e227cdb0.png

Q: Mnemonics take up too much space in the inventory and can only be dismantled one at a time.

2.Version 1.0 New Content Highlights


1. New Sects Introduced

Skyforge Pavilion was once part of the Imperial Six Ministries, specializing in enhancing Forging abilities. Members can dismantle and refine equipment, adding new attributes.

Linglang Swordhouse was established by the Emperor’s younger brother, King Linglang. Disciples use Sword Cases in combat and travel the world collecting famous swords.

Esoteric Buddhist Sect follows strict monastic discipline, promoting virtue. They have a unique Transcendence mechanic to guide others to enlightenment 
(their skills are tied to merit, so avoid taking lives!).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/aba0b10991249dcc55cb66099385c5e71a5148c9.png

Other sects require consulting elders within their ranks to unlock special features.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/7cb5b0c95d5ee65260ac891b640163cafc576ea8.png

Drunken Immortal's Parlor masters the art of Brew, granting unique buffs from drinking.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/9b7a8ed7c47a6478eb8ce248eece84aff4a5b1a6.png

Nethershade Cult can use exclusive medicinal skills for silent, bloodless victories.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/10ad7155dd56a4cf17843f3055f3fa49b413fad0.png

Five-dragon Cult now allows worm breeding and worm battling, creating powerful hybrid effects.



Oro Sword Sect can now form cold areas in snowy regions


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/d816bb7cb27084ba30eaf22a75806059e227e604.png

Fire God Vale provides new weapon and equipment blueprints, with the option to commission the crafting of divine weapons.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/6b4bf7bfe8a92bcc2369dfb4c8caefd484b96da1.png


Seance has enhanced fortune-telling, with the ability to perform divination with Moon Blocks for guidance.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/d158148d6669a8a3af0746f1cbcd2536e0cceae1.png

Millibeast Sect’s can now assign animals to collect resources

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/04c3b8ebab40f157048583c3a5891e11fef47b3d.png

Bamboo Pond members have access to a wider variety of Concealed Weapons, capable of weakening opponents before battle.


Heaven's End Palace masters meridian manipulation, enhancing Acupoints and unlocking new ones.


3. Character Abilities Reworked and Enhanced

Now abilities are ranked across six levels (Beginner, Expert, Veteran, Master, Guru, and Sage) for a total of 100 points. Each point increases the corresponding ability’s effect.

1 point of boxing experience will be converted into 1 point of boxing attack power

We have re-planned the learning and growth methods of all abilities. Now all abilities can be introduced through the behaviors that players can perform in the game.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/4051e8678a81489d9e409d25efe0ae6a77ffd701.png

4. Main Questline Expanded

The main questline is now available, and pacing has been adjusted. After reaching five plots, Dragonspring Town will unlock. Completing its events will trigger Sect Wayscroll events for each sect.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/92188f8ff4bb6e70ae286af0988ad31d45f968be.png

5. Inner Kungfu and Meridian System Redesign

Acupoints can now level up. Joining hidden sects unlocks additional levels and higher stats.
Upgraded Acupoints consume more qi, and inner techniques can be leveled up to three stages. Upgrading increases the load on meridians, requiring balance adjustments.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/dd4bda2b096ddcb0205e3a8dd6a670186ae4e40f.png

Dear players,

Thank you for standing by us on this journey. With your passion and encouragement, The Matchless Kungfu has grown and evolved to this point. Version 1.0 marks not only a new beginning for the game but a shared achievement for us all. We hope you’ll continue to find joy and challenge in this world.

The The Matchless Kungfu Development and Publishing Team

notes.title: 20241106 V1.0.0.0 update
notes.content:
Additions

1. Three New Sects: We’ve added three completely new sects, complete with their own unique locations, *Inner Kungfu*, *skills*, and gameplay features.

2. Overhaul of Personal Abilities: Characters’ personal abilities have undergone a large-scale rework, now with six tiers (*Beginner*, *Expert*, *Veteran*, *Master*, *Guru*, and *Sage*) across a total of 100 points. Even if you don’t level up, any 1-point increase in stats will provide a corresponding ability boost.  
   - For example, each point in fist skill translates into an increase in *Fist ATK*, and every point in *Geomancy* will add a 1% boost to lockpicking and stealing success rates, among other similar effects.

3. Redesigned Consult Function: Now, consulting on *skills* and *Inner Kungfu* doesn’t directly teach the ability. Instead, it progresses the *Inner Kungfu* and *skills* into a state of insight, where progress gradually builds according to the character’s understanding until the *skill* or *Inner Kungfu* is fully learned.

4. Reworked Learning Function: Instead of simply increasing the corresponding ability attribute, learning now boosts the rate at which experience for that ability is gained over a certain period. The higher the other character’s ability level, the greater the experience boost.  
   - We’ve revamped the learning and growth paths for all abilities—now, all abilities can be learned through actions available to players in the game.
   - When teaching *Inner Kungfu* or *skills* to NPCs, they will now express great gratitude, significantly boosting favor. However, for a short time after, NPCs will not gain favor simply from further instruction in *Inner Kungfu* or *skills*.

5. Revamped Meridian and *Inner Kungfu* Systems: Added new *Acupoint* upgrades, *Inner Kungfu* upgrades, and reverse cultivation methods for *Inner Kungfu*.
   - *Acupoints* can now be leveled up by joining specific sects, increasing attributes.
   - Each upgraded *Acupoint* will consume more qi once linked.
   - *Inner Kungfu* can be upgraded to increase its effects, with a maximum of three levels available.
   - Reverse cultivation requires the corresponding reverse cultivation manual, which can then be activated by pressing the reverse cultivation button on *Inner Kungfu*. However, reverse cultivation flips the activation order of the *Acupoints*.
   - If your meridian setup doesn’t support this reversed activation, you may understand the method but cannot correctly use it.

6. Revised Combat Mechanics: Rebalanced combat values—*skills* now have a stronger impact on move damage, while *Inner Kungfu* has less effect on move damage.

7. New Sect Features: Eight major sects now have official names and unique gameplay features.  
   - Drunken Immortal's Parlor: Formerly the drunken sect, this sect masters the art of *Brew* in the vast wilderness, providing unique buffs through drinking.
   - Nethershade Cult: Formerly the poison sect, Nethershade Cult specializes in unique elixirs, allowing members to triumph effortlessly.
   - Five-dragon Cult: Formerly the worm sect, Five-dragon Cult now has capabilities in worm cultivation and combat. Cultivating worms eliminates the need to hunt them daily, while combat allows the combination of worms for new effects.
   - Oro Sword Sect: Formerly the ice sect, Oro Sword Sect now has the ability to form *cold areas* in icy terrain, although their overall abilities remain the same.
   - Fire God Vale: Formerly the heat sect, Fire God Vale now holds a monopoly on blueprints and forging improvements for weapons and equipment, although you may commission them for artifact forging even if you don’t join them.
   - Seance: Formerly the misfortune sect, Seance now offers *divination* for guidance using the *Moon Block*.
   - Millibeast Sect: Formerly the beast sect, members can now send animals to gather resources and use *Dragonform* on animals with reworked *Inner Kungfu*.
   - Bamboo Pond: Formerly the concealed weapon sect, Bamboo Pond members have access to various new *Concealed Weapons* to weaken opponents before combat, which can be crafted using blueprints by a skilled craftsman.
   - Heaven's End Palace: Previously a hidden sect, now they wield knowledge of human meridians, aiding in *Acupoint* upgrades and new *Acupoints*.  

   Hidden sects now all have official names, including Shaolin, Iron Armor Alliance, Wudang, Beggar Gang, and Tianya Sword Alliance. Players can unlock *Sect Wayscrolls* in-game through *events*, providing opportunities to join these sects.  
   - Skyforge Pavilion: Formerly part of the royal government’s Ministry of Works, this new sect holds advanced *Forging* abilities and can dismantle, cleanse, and add inscriptions to equipment.
   - Linglang Swordhouse: Founded by a prince, this new sect’s disciples wield *Sword Cases* in combat and roam the world collecting famous swords.
   - Esoteric Buddhist Sect: This new Buddhist sect guides others toward good through strict rules, possessing the unique *Transcendence* ability, helping others abandon past wrongs and embrace enlightenment.

   Players who do not wish to join an established sect may establish their own, gaining access to the abilities of defeated sects. A custom sect can include abilities from sects eliminated by the player; it’s even possible to create a sect with all abilities by conquering all others.

8. New Main Storyline: Expanded and restructured the main storyline’s pacing. Now, five plots unlock Dragonspring Town, and after completing its storyline, *events* will trigger on town plots where sect representatives can grant *Sect Wayscrolls*, allowing players to join.

9. Enhanced *Skills* and *Inner Kungfu* Learning in Sects: Players can now talk to a sect *Salute* to learn the sect’s *Inner Kungfu* and *skills* through specific dialogue options.

10. Revised Wooden Poles Function: Wooden poles now allow players to practice move skills and *skills* (currently equipped ones). Practicing *skills* also advances the progress of *skills* that are being learned.

11. Revised Sneak Feature: Sneak mode now accurately hides players, and it’s possible to escape pursuing NPCs by sneaking. Success in sneaking depends on the Sneak skill, and being detected briefly disables re-entering Sneak.

12. Revamped Abilities Like *Geomancy* and *Fly On Snow*: Theft no longer has a value cap, and *Geomancy* now boosts the success rate for both stealing and lockpicking.

13. Overhauled *Inner Kungfu* Effects: The effects of *Inner Kungfu* have been thoroughly reworked across the game, resulting in fresh experiences.

14. Revamped Martial Arts Moves: NPCs no longer perform *Yin Leg* or *Slap* (unless taught by the player). Replaced with Taizu Long Fist, Large Pi Gua Palm, and Six Styles Flick Leg. *Yin Leg* and *Slap* are now exclusive *skills* for players.

15. Reworked Production System: Almost all equipment and item recipes now require blueprints, typically gained by joining the respective sect or through treasure map *events*.

16. New Interactions: Players can now carry unconscious characters to beds, allowing forced sharing of the bed.

---

 Optimization

1. Improved *Events* System: No longer reliant on dialogue responses, NPCs assigned *event* tasks will now display an *event* button that, when clicked, completes the task.

2. Improved Farming System: Farming now includes watering and fertilizing to boost yields. Different crops also have preferred terrains that further increase yield. Added a one-click harvest option to collect all mature crops on a plot simultaneously.

---

 Fixes

1. Bug Fixes: Resolved numerous bugs throughout the game.

2. Logic Adjustments: For example, attacking bandits or notorious NPCs/buildings no longer increases infamy.

Dear Heroes! Here we are!

After more than one year of development, we are nervous to announce that "The Matchless Kungfu" will launch its 1.0 release version on November 7, 2024, Beijing time!

Since the game's EA launch, the suggestions, support, and feedback from all heroes have been immensely helpful to us. However, we apologize for the limited aspects and feedback we could address.

In the past two months, we have not made significant version updates, only filling in the events content, which is also in preparation for the game's 1.0 release. We will continue to maintain updates of events and optimized content before the 1.0 version goes live.

In the next two months, we will fully commit to the development of the 1.0 version content, hoping to bring you a different feeling of "The Matchless Kungfu," allowing everyone to find the "freedom" and "jianghu spirit" in it. We want more players to fall in love with our game and also want the players who already like it to have a different experience. As a small studio, we are well aware that this is actually quite difficult. Due to the initial underlying framework, we cannot optimize many aspects quickly. We hope for your understanding and thank you again for your continuous support!

After the release of version 1.0, we will continue to develop and maintain the update of the content of "The Matchless Kungfu". 

At the same time, after part of the content of version 1.0 is completed, we will invite some players to participate in the test. You can join our discord community or follow our official steam to get relevant information.

notes.title: Simple development VOL 3
notes.content:
A Chat with All Heroes~~

It's been more than a month since our last update. We sincerely thank you all for your timely feedback on bugs and other issues. However, due to various factors, our communication with you has been limited. You might not know what we’ve been working on, and that's on us. We admit we lack experience in this regard. After much thought, we’ve decided to share a brief development log to give you a glimpse into our upcoming work.


What We're Working on Now

Adventure Content Updates

Over the next three months, we will continue developing brand-new adventures, ensuring that each month we add at least three new adventures to existing land plots. We hope these additions will bring you a fresh experience in the martial arts world, with each plot featuring 1-3 different quests and minor exploration content.
For example, as seen in our previous update, meditating under the Swallow Falls increases your health—an adventure that doesn’t rely solely on dialogue.


NPC AI LOD Range Adjustment

Many of you have pointed out that NPCs become stationary when you move far away from them. Initially, this design was meant to accommodate players with lower-end hardware to prevent lag when navigating through multiple plots.

In last week’s update, we introduced a new feature: AI activation range adjustment. We invite all heroes to help test this system's effectiveness.
There are four levels: 1, 2, 4, and Unlimited. The first three levels are multiples of the original AI range, and setting it to Unlimited will allow AI activity across 144 plots in real-time. If you experience any lag, please reduce the range accordingly.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/de302fcd937b085b220669c67e68dd9aec87da95.png

Players with systems that meet or exceed the recommended specs can set the AI range to 4x or higher for a smooth experience

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/a13f7912dc7c252d6c7e24182b5d97a674b56501.png

NPC AI Optimization

We have introduced a new background evolution feature. Now, when NPCs are not in the active area, their relationship will still evolve. We will continue to improve this system based on your feedback and suggestions.

In addition, we have improved the aggressive behavior of NPCs. NPCs will no longer attack players because of low favorability. Instead, if NPCs dislike players due to negative behavior or conflict, they will express their dissatisfaction through whispers. NPCs will only attack players if they behave maliciously near these NPCs or have a grudge against them.


Sect Uniqueness Adjustment

We’ve heard from many of you that aside from differences in martial arts and geography, the sects don’t feel all that distinct. To address this, we’re planning a significant overhaul of sect gameplay to make each one truly unique.

Each sect will be given a special gameplay mechanic. For example, the Misfortune Sect will introduce a divination system, where drawing lots can grant various buffs and effects. The Drunken Sect will focus on brewing different types of alcohol, while the Poison Mist Sect will have more recipes for crafting poisons and medicines.
Our goal is to make each sect more distinctive and embody the true spirit of the martial world.

(The above are development screenshots, representing only a portion of the content in development. Quantity and effects are for reference only.)


Future Plans

Lot Adjustment Function

We are currently researching and developing a feature that will allow players to modify the positions of land plots once certain conditions are met. Please be patient, as this feature is still in the works

Main Storyline

The main storyline has been a highly requested feature, and we’re working to provide a balanced and reasonable narrative experience within our current framework. We plan to enhance the story from the point where players arrive in Longquan Town to their eventual rise as the leader of the martial world.
However, The Matchless Kungfu is not a linear narrative game. The story exists to fill in the missing elements of the world’s lore and background. Our primary focus will continue to be on gameplay, with the main story serving as a guide through key points in the game.


More Sects and Supreme Arts

We’re currently developing new sects and supreme arts, distinct from the previously introduced Royal City and Assassin paths. These new sects will each have their own complete systems of supreme arts and gameplay mechanics:

Skyforge Pavilion: Specializes in heavy weaponry. Their supreme art, "Force," allows them to accumulate and control "Force" during combat. The more "Force" they have, the higher the damage they can deal. However, accumulating too much "Force" can put them at a disadvantage.

Linglong Swordhouse: Focuses on the unique sword casket gameplay. The sword casket is a special piece of equipment that only Swordhouse disciples can fully utilize

Esoteric Buddhist Sect: Specializes in persuasion and conversion. They have a unique mechanism called "Persuasion." When certain conditions are met, they can directly convince opponents to abandon their weapons and seek enlightenment. Additionally, the Esoteric Sect excels in verbal duels and is highly skilled in Buddhist teachings.


More Immersive and Fun Features

Nickname System: Masters in the martial world often have nicknames or titles, like "Thunderbolt Hand" or "Golden Lion King." In future updates, we’ll be adding nicknames for special NPCs, who will be world-renowned experts with unique martial arts techniques. Players who complete specific quests can earn these nicknames and choose one to stand out in the martial world.

Acupoint Upgrades and Internal Skill Enhancements are also in the design phase and will be introduced in the next major update. We’re also working on several other improvements to enhance your experience, such as merging farm harvests, raising Gu insects, optimizing music gameplay, refining NPC AI behavior, and overhauling core stats to better tie in with abilities.




A Final Word

We’ve seen and heard all your thoughts and feedback. Every member of our team grew up with wuxia novels, and we truly understand the passion behind your suggestions. Many of your ideas are not just good—they’re fantastic. Internally, we’ve discussed them at length and believe they align perfectly with what we want to achieve. We’ve received many suggestions for feature optimizations, and these ideas are often things we’ve also dreamt of implementing. However, due to various constraints, we haven’t been able to immediately bring them to life in the game

Over the past few months, we’ve restructured much of the underlying code in The Matchless Kungfu, enabling us to support features that were previously impossible. This has allowed us to develop many of the exciting additions mentioned here.

At the end of this month, we’ll be releasing a detailed update plan and schedule for the next three months. We hope you’ll come back to see what’s in store. Finally, we want to express our deepest gratitude to all the heroes who have supported The Matchless Kungfu. Your support means the world to us, and we promise to keep improving and updating the game.

The Matchless Kungfu
August 9, 2024

notes.title: 【Version Update】 TOP OF MARTIAL ARTS
notes.content:
The latest update has arrived! Since the game's launch, your heroes have been providing feedback regarding combat difficulty and experience, which is we solved during this update.  We've introduced a new "Mnemonic" system, allowing heroes to integrate these Mnemonic into their Skills, creating a variety of martial arts combinations.To make the game's Energy and Chi more aligned with the authentic martial arts of the Jianghu, we've incorporated a cost for using Skills. The amount of Energy and Chi will now directly impact the damage of these skills, and the current level of Energy will also determine a player's defensive strength when fending off enemy attacks.
In addition, we've adjusted the strength of NPCs. Based on their power, NPCs are now categorized into nine levels, with higher-level NPCs being more formidable and holding a higher status in the Jianghu world. Following this update, several hermit will emerge, each with their own powerful skills. Players will need to be carefully in their search to uncover these hidden figures.
This update also brings a new fashion feature, allowing heroes to easily install and remove downloaded fashion mods.
There must be anticipate encountering various issues at the beggin of version. We warmly invite you heroes to report any bugs through the in-game bug reporting feature or by leaving comments on the Steam platform, helping us to improve the game's content!

Here's a detailed breakdown of the updates in Top of Martial Arts:


1.Rework Skills System

After updating to the latest version, Skills are now categorized into five tiers and nine levels.

Tiers indicate the quality of the skill, ranging from a 【face slap】 at tier one to the devastating 【Annihilate】 at tier five, each with distinct UI representations:
Tier 1: No border
Tier 2: Snake border
Tier 3: Double snake border
Tier 4: Dragon border
Tier 5: Double dragon border


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/f1d0d08e9e3e729f81e11e2a5fb8acf102ec6f7b.png

Levels represent the power in the skill, with progression similar to the  system. Players can upgrade their skills by using them and applying Kungfu insights. Skills above level 7 cannot be advance with insights alone. Upon reaching levels 3, 6, and 9, a new slot for a Mnemonic will unlock.

Level 1: Novice
Level 2: Normal 
Level 3: Skilled 
Level 4: Master   
Level 5: Grandmaster
Level 6: Professional
Level 7: Perfected 
Level 8: Legendary
Level 9: Peerless 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/56d068e05a1a80bc6abe87ef0e58385c1219d438.png

The combat value framework has been rebuild, with Energy and Chi now linked to the damage of Skills.
Defensive strength has been added, which the character's Energy will affect their own defensive strength, with higher remaining Energy resulting in higher defensive strength.
At the same time, releasing Skills will reduce Energy, with the value displayed in blue above the skill.
A new Energy bar has been added outside the Vigor bar to display the current character's Energy value.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/81e7db512748056d62fe7d017f4905796fce2076.png

Related Energy adjustments:
1、Permanent Energy recovery adjustment: 5% / 3 S → 5 / 3 S out of combat, recovering 5 points of Energy per turn in combat.
2、Mounts such as horses, eagles, and carriages no longer consume Energy, climbing no longer consumes Energy, and the first part of Qinggong no longer consumes Energy.



2.Mnemonic System 

 A new Mnemonic system has been added, allowing players to equip Mnemonic on their Skills to provide additional numerical bonuses or special effects, which will be displayed on the left side of the ultimate skill page.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/f0d33537b651125c66249a198ed940415349d533.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/6fdb9367964a26f2307192da89647c1eed7f9cdb.png

Mnemonic can be obtained by consuming Kungfu insights or move insights at the Enlightenment Stones of the Skills that have been acquire.
The method of obtaining move insights is to improve the corresponding skill, such as obtaining a Fist move insight when reaching the beginner level in Fist.
Some daily interactions can also yield move insights, such as spar, battle, attack, etc.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/fc51aebfe3b3e95e347f73328349a3c378b520c6.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/ae9837ede575c8330009a69e9a1ae583392e22bd.png

The Mnemonic drawn by Kungfu insights are random types, while those drawn using move Skills will be the corresponding Mnemonic.
There are no hard requirements for the type of Mnemonic that can be equipped; for example, a Fist skill can also be equipped with a leg technique Mnemonic.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/2f6d99e0d447cd4bcaf43601bb3c5ef59f48b52d.png

Mnemonics come in four qualities:
With this update, there will be nearly 140 Mnemonic for players to freely build their own skill system. 
Normal, Rare, Excellent, and Perfect

Some Perfect Mnemonic have specific skill requirements.
Since this adjustment involves underlying combat, the originally planned Skills have been temporarily postponed, and we will continue to add new Skills and Mnemonic in subsequent versions, including the highly anticipated Sect-exclusive Skills that will be added in coming versions.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/1d8260e7ae5b52cd228b2405f47d0f99451523d8.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/8007d0f8cf3ec28266cf274a69b4a33de1320ddd.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/8d86db2491f960ca853e417a65594dcb059ac509.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/9791c737410a7e2d1ba500b02f7ce0e5dd0c827f.png

3.NPC——强度优化

NPCs will be divided into 9 levels, with higher-level NPCs being stronger and having a higher status in the Jianghu. 
Player characters will also use this rating, but the strength rating does not represent actual combat power. However, in most cases, characters with a higher strength rating are stronger than those with a lower strength rating. NPCs will grow in ability according to the player's strength rating.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/c81d6c367934be7183b40417006039e85cbc3cf7.png

Hermit：
This update adds several hermits, and players can inquire about their message at the bartender after that triggering related events. Currently, this is a preliminary version feature, just for initial experience, so it is triggered in this way to facilitate those who want to experience it. Later, we will optimize the quest and events systems. Players can become friends with hermits by completing their tasks or fighting and sparring with them to learn their unique Mnemonic.


4.Fashion System

A new fashion feature has been added, allowing players to directly use model mods with fashion labels subscribed in the Steam Workshop after activation.
 (Every model mods can now be freely used, without the need to equip specific equipment.)


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/b4aa78cc48ae1686b0c1224b923e79ed97532941.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/af21cb1c4959985d103b9de1cba71e6b138a7da4.png

The model mod takes effect with one click, and canceling the outfit will revert to the default.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/727ef16f6a599e82604f231e1f412dfcd3c74741.png


Heroes need to follow the standards to produce fashion mods that can take effect in the game


5.Other Optimizations and Changes

1. The damage that Skills can cause will be directly displayed on the cards.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/08231d2d88ced29cd0a74c479d277ef4823deeb3.png

2. Players will have tolerance when using items that increase Chi, and the effect will be affected after the Chi exceeds 200.
3. Players gain a 5-point Chi for each new internal skill they learn (no activation required).
4. The new player guidance process has been optimized.


With this update, players can mix and match their Kungfu styles and experiment with various combinations of Skills and Mnemonic. We encourage players to create new characters to fully experience the game's content. We look forward to witnessing the diverse and novel experiences our players will have.
We will continue to add the storylines and content that our players are eager for, with a focus on enhancing the game's atmosphere and providing an excellent martial arts experience.
 As always, if you encounter any issues or have suggestions while exploring the new content, please let us know through the in-game bug reporting system, Steam forums, or the comments section of this post.
Until we meet again, guys!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/785cbd0f4ad0b247670d3498d4073194964dac57.png

At the raw material input, players can select the source of raw materials (「Forest」
, 「Quarry」, 「Beast Fence」). Multiple selections are possible, such as two forests providing 2 woods at the same time. F
At the synthesizer, players can select the target item to be forged. 
Special note: all factory simulation modules need to be connected by conveyor belts.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/c0dc01409902e96b3c51c8d373d1a25b8ee0bd0f.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/15a797dfd7951bcdd5e97b1f48b7816c75ffebea.png

How to get NPCs' help

Players can stun NPCs and then carry them to the work module. This allows the NPC to start working (only one worker per module). 
Players can interact with a worker who is already working by the 'release' button, which interrupts their work.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/7ea8981880920a67a8165660b0df22a3ace18310.png

2.Achievements System - Content Introduction

When the player's have 4 plots, they can trigger the adventure of the Encyclopedia. (It will also work when players have more than 4 plots)
 When this adventure is triggered, if the player's faction's plots are greater than or equal to 2, they can trigger the adventure of theJianghu Mystery.
Once any character unlocks the systems, they are unlocked for all characters.
After unlocking, they can be viewed in the Achievements, and the items obtained after unlocking are automatically included in the collection system.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/453c399720bc44230b900d1adce2e2b406c7167b.png

Encyclopedia: Milliherb, Materials, Elixir, Cuisine, Mechanism, and Architecture.
Jianghu Mystery:  Weapons, Gear, Skills, Inner Kungfu, and Influence.
After collecting a certain quantity, players can click on the top right corner to receive rewards.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/51d77c1aeba86957ffdf269d5160119a9bf87390.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/f3d4b9bae012288ba64fbd8bd002871fe4ddb6e9.png

3.New Function - Building Blueprint Modification

After this update, all buildings support remodeling. Players can modify their buildings, change decorations, and so on. 
Note: reducing the original floor area will not refund building materials. Expanding or adding facilities requires additional building materials. Expansion cannot exceed the original size limit. 
You need to click "Finish" to successfully complete the remodeling.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/00ab2eba75f3d927d3017e4451ffef42a9e9cfca.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/10c4b483f07dab3bb4796b91054df21c926feb7e.png

4.Improving for the Mod Editor:

1. Automatic reading of configuration tables.
2. Whispering bubbles can now be used in dialogue events.
3. Support for continuous plot events.


Above is the introduction to the new version of "The Billions". Heroes can now embark on your journey to become a business tycoon, building your own professional assembly line, "hiring" workers to work for you, becoming wealthy landowners, and exploring uncharted territories in the world according to the Achievements!

As always, if you encounter any problems while playing the new content. or if you have any better suggestions, you can tell us through the in-game bug submission link, or on the Steam forum, and in the comments section of this post!

Farewell, heroes! See you next time!

notes.title: 【The Night Crow Version Update】Assassin Faction Version Introduction
notes.content:
【The Night Crow Version Update】Assassin Faction Version Introduction

Greetings, heroes! Time flies, and The Night Crow (Assassin System) has finally arrived. The Assassin, a perpetually mysterious profession, infiltrates everywhere. After this update, a new faction, The Night Crow, will emerge in your small world. Your friends, your teachers, even those who share your sentiments, could all be members of this organization. Players can also join The Night Crow, becoming a hidden assassin, gradually rising to become the head of The Night Crow. Henceforth, when you make enemies, think carefully; your numerous enemies might post bounties to hire assassins to kill you. Similarly, you can also post bounties for your enemies. The martial world is treacherous, so please be cautious, heroes!


At the beginning of The Night Crow version update, there will inevitably be issues with the game. We welcome all heroes to submit problems through the in-game bug button or the Steam comment section to help us discover bugs and improve the game content!

At the same time, we want to apologize here. Due to the Destiny System involving changes and adjustments to all systems, if we rush the modification and redoing, the experience presented to you, heroes, will not be what we desire. Therefore, we have decided to postpone the remaking of the Destiny System, and the next major update is expected to focus on deepening and enriching the operation module! Thank you for your support, heroes!

Here is a detailed introduction to The Night Crow update:

1. The Night Crow - Faction Introduction

After updating the game to the latest version, when a player has three adversaries, it triggers an assassination event, and at the same time, The Night Crow faction is formed.
- When a player's reputation is "inhuman," the assassin organization will come to recruit the player.
- The assassin's identity cannot be recognized through the NPC interface; it can only be known through the Assassin List.
- Players can both join a sect and the assassin faction. (Players cannot see this faction in the faction interface before joining The Night Crow faction.)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/c2e92f3ba7748699e9cd7cc7e274fd2b14c3e78d.png

The Night Crow faction is pervasive; there are assassins hidden in every region.
- In front of the Black Crow Mountain Cave, there is a Blood Monument. After joining The Night Crow faction, players can interact with it.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/819b74436d3ffadd0669a3303ae2977a18b727c8.png

How to join The Night Crow faction:
- After triggering the assassination event, players will receive a Blood Strip. Using it at a high place at night will summon the Instructor and allow players to join The Night Crow faction.
- (There is a chance to purchase the Blood Strip directly from a merchant ship.)


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/5ddbedad1e45e94cb15214add226ffa07280d7e8.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/4ea5d66eea5eaa318bc7273edd66cdbe2a4d669a.png

After obtaining the Blood Strip, players can also publish assassinations at the well (without identity restrictions).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/a6ea346e6abaf73acc77ec5a4a7ef397045ded87.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/022cd336517360ca1fdf76c5cf4e82ddf6dd6a18.png

After becoming an assassin, players can receive assassination missions at the well, and after completing the mission, they will receive Blood Coins, a special currency for the The Night Crow.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/1396ca026efbd860c4589821ca857b870ca60277.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/3fae62f47494c60f5c1353913f990fb7fb9c4d9a.png

After completing the assassination, players can use the Blood Strip at night to summon the Instructor and receive rewards

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/584b45bfd532c8b8a9d07c6ab3bc9db680da8b28.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/f157e10c3e439e94a021fcc4c7472aa224ec86ea.png

The Blood Coins obtained from completing Killing Order can be used to exchange items or upgrade status at the Blood Monument.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/756633aa8240a8c3226ab4c6165bd631aa3ec51f.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/9fcb1be2e3917be47ac383cb00e18d571617758f.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/7f987a04faa12b79c19928901b6e6c0874cbd749.png

2.The Night Crow - Faction Level Introduction

- The Night Crow has five status levels: Assassin Soldier, Captain of Assassin, Major of Assassin, Colonel of Assassin, and General of Assassin.
- The middle three levels can be directly promoted through the Blood Monument.
- After becoming a Major of Assassin, players can exchange the Assassin List with Blood Coins.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/94e1c5c18304e817e129df5d3bb938667d4b3965.png

The Assassin List can view specific information about organization members below the Colonel of Assassin level.
(Cannot view information about Colonel of Assassin and General of Assassin.)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/3de6eacdedebec873fb5a9abcd7d23f3c8b28327.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/db6c368b79998eaf37f22f1e87bb4f3fd3be1b83.png

When a player is at the Colonel of Assassin or General of Assassin level, they can issue a death notice to any character in the action interface.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/3007a48576881083e76039b14adfecf86ee7da76.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/4fa4f9e375f16923f344c114026746acfa3a543e.png

When a player is at the General of Assassin level, they can issue Killing Order and No-Survivors Order in the action interface.

- Killing Order: Adds the target to the assassination list.
- No-Survivors Order: Adds everyone in the target sect to the assassination list (excluding NPCs with assassin identities in the sect).
- At the same time, there can only be one General of Assassin. Only by killing the previous General of Assassin can one become the new General of Assassin.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/36447cf64a0256128fee850f1e8abbb3feb94de4.png

It is said that becoming a General of Assassin will reveal some secret information, perhaps enabling the discovery of treasure left behind by the previous General of Assassin and secret Inner Kungfu (after activation, an Ambush button will be added to the stealth page).
However, the actions of a General of Assassin are extremely secretive and can only be discerned through inference.


3.The Night Crow - New Status and Item Introduction

- Death Notice: When a death notice is issued by The Night Crow, the person is easy to attacks from those with bad reputations, leading to a continuous decrease in their mood. Killing someone with a death notice rewards Blood Coins and Killing Qi.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/11a93dfc700078c68aac2821ee8480ec09325516.png

Killing Qi: People around you will fear you. When facing cowardly people, Verbal Duel increase by 20%.
1. Obtained after killing assassination targets.
2. Obtained after killing someone with a death notice.


Dying: Increases by 1 layer each day, up to a maximum of 4 layers, causing severe hidden ailments when increased. From the second layer to the fourth layer, it accumulates 180 severe hidden ailments. Can be obtained after using the Three-day Dying Powder.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/db307b40cceb103f35d16c876904e78da39c1e2e.png

Weakness: Reduces movement speed and increases damage received by 100%. Can be obtained after using the Weakness Powder.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/dff6b93add3a921b738d15f2b01e534ea3ed3b7f.png

- Acupoint-blocking: Can be obtained after using the Acupoint-blocking Pill.
For players: Randomly disables 1 normal acupoint per layer.
For NPCs: If the layer is greater than or equal to 3, disables 1 random inner Kungfu; if the layer is greater than or equal to 6, disables 2 random inner Kungfu; if the layer is greater than or equal to 9, disables 3 random inner Kungfu; if the layer is greater than or equal to 12, disables 4 random inner Kungfu; if the layer is greater than or equal to 15, disables all inner Kungfu.
(After being cleared, the disabled inner Kungfu need to be reactivated based on the remaining layers.)


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/0f2d267ae4daee8d6d198ee7ff39f865e68362fe.png

Killing Qi Pill: Permanently converts Killing Qi into a random martial attack. When used, there is a chance of causing a「Hysteria」

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/5e14e56fd87d189627d197dea24cb648189f206b.png



4.The Night Crow - New Event Introduction

1. Assassin Interception Event:
When a player has three adversaries, there is a chance of triggering the Assassin Interception event. After killing the assassin, players will receive a Blood Strip, and The Night Crow faction will be generated in the small world.

2. Recruitment Event:
When a player's reputation is "inhuman," the assassin organization will come to recruit the player.

3. Assassination of the General of Assassin:
When a player is at the General of Assassin level, there is a chance that NPCs at the Colonel of Assassin level will lead a team to assassinate the player at night and seize the position of General of Assassin.
 
These are introductions to the content of The Night Crow (Assassin Faction) in this version. The martial world is perilous, and assassins are everywhere. Perhaps one of the people around you is a member. Will you choose to join the organization and weather the storm or choose to stand alone and avoid the storm? But can you really escape?
 
As always, if heroes encounter any problems while playing the new content or have any better suggestions, you can use the in-game bug submission link, Steam forum, or the comment section of this post to let us know!
 
Farewell for now, heroes!

notes.title: Introduction to the Imperial Power Update
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! We have finally brought you the Imperial Power update! Just as we previously announced, after the update, all you "outlaws" should think twice before committingmore crimes. Crimesare no longer as simple as they used to be. Those who commit numerous evil deeds will be listed on the Blacklist (Wanted List), and the Imperial guards will administer righteous punishment! Furthermore, those defeated by the Imperial guards will be imprisoned in the prison. Escaping from the prison is hard; it will test your financial resources and the support of your friends and connections. At the same time, players can choose to join the Imperial guards and become enforcers of justice. However, becoming an Imperial guard is not easy; it requires giving up something "important." Whether you are an Imperial guard or a person of the martial world, please take care yourself, as the martial world is treacherous!

At the same time, the building blueprints of the mod maker are updated simultaneously. You can design your own building blueprints and upload them to the creative workshop to share!

There will undoubtedly be some issues with the game at the beginning of the Imperial Power update. We welcome all of you to submit bugs through the in-game bug report button or the Steam community to help us identify and improve the game's content!
The following is a detailed introduction to this update of the Imperial Power:



1.Introduction to the Imperial Power -Lot

After updating the game to the latest version

you can directly unlock the Imperial Power Lot and influence by opening a large Lot. Or, when a player's crime score reaches level 3 and the Imperial Power Lot has not been unlocked, an event will be triggered to unlock it.
   (Sect opening territory cannot select the Imperial Power Lot)



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/78e24294ea3355d9f74209f2b247ff0bc0e34c88.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/6d8760abf0faf710886aeffbfa4d73c6a2a43308.png

The Imperial Power inner city is an Imperial guard camp in the shape of an upper palace, surrounded by some ordinary buildings and operational buildings. The lower level is a prison for imprisoning criminals.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/207caa6db4a59bb5b1f8b034c8f1d17d5ea435cd.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/8d4303f12f430cd32d3e4ab1d21603440e5964ab.png

Wanted List
Every day, everyone's criminality will be evaluated here. When a player's crime score reaches a certain level, they will be listed on it.
 (Imperial guards, Huanmos Servant, players imprisoned in the dungeon, and NPCs already listed will not be repeatedly wanted.)
Crime score will increase when your evil act was witnessed by someone. Moreover, abolishing someone's martial arts or disabling them will directly increase crime score.
(You can bribe the guards above the level of Pacification Commissioner to reduce crime score.)
   (Imperial guards can directly mark the position of NPCs on the wanted list.)



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/436cb9d4753c9d9ffd94de54ab90efb5f44d3e8b.png

2.Introduction to the Imperial Power - Imperial Guards

The Imperial guards are a special army under the Emperor's command, responsible for punishing wrongdoers in the martial world.
You can become an Imperial guard by talking to a Pacification Commissioner or a higher-level guard.
   (Imperial guards can use the open station for free and have the option to break down doors.)
(Male characters need to self-castration to join.)
   Self-castration: The target must be male and equipped with a sword.
(Female characters cannot join the Introduction guards at present, but there will be ways for them to join later, such as through imperial examinations)



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/0131da6f05626aa2a37a223b05697467d7f5ebb4.png

After becoming a guard, you will gain exclusive Inner Kungfu Sun Tracker and a special weapon Soul Hook.
(Non- Imperial guards wearing guard-exclusive equipment will be wanted.)


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/76b7f260532fe6d1367fd137fab129df7705700a.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/e7b1ed5e3952c7e9f56bcb351ac5e29ebf07c199.png

There are four levels of guards: Small Flag, General Flag, Pacification Commissioner, and Commanding Officer.

Imperial guards receive a salary every three days after joining. The higher the level, the better the rewards.
Players can increase their Imperial Power reputation by capturing wanted criminals. When it reaches a certain score, they can trade in the wanted list for official silver and promotion.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/fcc99eb0753073dd8d514b7902ec321623c60b68.png
Each promotion also grants corresponding exclusive equipment.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/3aaab911b93cd44a4da686b36fca8e4854b0f8c5.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/0a1518f4b4bd1505b8c4dabaf41d369a7a506424.png

3.Introduction to the Imperial Power - New Statuses and Items

Eunuch: Can learn the exclusive Inner Kungfu Sun Tracker. Cannot build romantic relationships with NPCs and will receive 30 points of Despise when seen by others.
(You can find a doctor with a high medical skill level to cure the eunuch status by carrying a manly.)


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/fa9b470bdbf12563af2d4da4171d30ab6e586e2e.png

 Fulfill Official Duties: Obtained after equipping the Guards’ sword.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/dc3a89ddaaa316eaa3d43ff51c37100e4e310d9e.png

Imperial Authorization: When equipped with the Guards’ Hat, Guards’ Clothes, and Guards’ Pants, greeting will default to choosing a lower-ranking guard in the vicinity.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/600fe200ff1146c76eea3974e9396ca392704b88.png

Soul Lock: There is a chance to obtain it after being attacked by the Soul Hook.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/a8f2c587ce69285124915fb33d62b7d5daf4bb90.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/8d20364a0937139a34ae5b9493265034b9dc7a41.png 

Broad Daylight: Activated after using the exclusive Inner Kungfu Sun Tracker, increasing movement speed by 20% during the day.
Wanted Criminal: Obtained after being wanted.
Piercing Pipa Bone: Obtained after being imprisoned in the water prison, unable to use Inner Kungfu or Skills.
Overlord Body-Refining: Obtained after taking the Overlord Body-Refining Pill, gaining 300 points of Qi.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/9d41bca9d1c46e4c1127f00e6f2ff610e6c443c9.png

Soul Separation: Doubles the number of required moves for Skills when used on a target with the Three-Soul Separation Pill.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/29e6250f0a0eb8402f455e325d6f09eab33470bf.png

King's Revolt-Subduing: Removes the usage conditions for Skills, increases damage by 50%, but causes 20 bouts of Hysteria.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/d59091b17d03eb1b0b76b70f8909f658932d8b70.png


Official Silver: Exclusive currency of the Imperial City.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/0255c665cd07cf8e612075bb373605c5cfdfb996.png

Manly: Automatically obtained after becoming a eunuch.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996541/2558132170a46c7a8dd1158e0fcd2e98437f1e17.png

4.Introduction to the Imperial Power - New Events

1.Wanted Criminal Event

Different levels of Imperial guards will be dispatched based on the criminal's level. A wanted criminal of levels 1-4 can choose to resist arrest or pay a fine upon capture. Paying the fine clears the crim score, while failing to resist arrest results in imprisonment in the Imperial City prison. A level 5 wanted criminal cannot resist and just only be fought.


2.Beheading Event

If a player becomes a level 5 wanted criminal and is imprisoned in the prison, a waiting-to-be-beheaded event will be triggered, where an executioner will execute the player. If the executioner is righteous, the player will be beheaded immediately. If the executioner has a negative reputation, a bribery event will be triggered, and upon completion, the crim score will be cleared.


3.3.Jailbreak

If a player triggers the waiting-to-be-beheaded event, characters with high relationships or connections can attempt a jailbreak. If successful, they will rescue the player from captivity. Otherwise, the player will be beheaded.
